messages:
sam_runtime: heads up — autoscaling alert for hosted-us-west-2. p99 jumped to ~3.2s around 17:24 UTC, queue depth for shard-42 hit 120. looks like kernel selector churn + long kv lookups.

maria_sre: on it. seeing similar in the metrics dash. any correlation with ratecap events or tenant burst? :eyes:

sam_runtime: ratecap didn't change. traffic spike was modest (x1.4) but requests skewed to longer sequences. i see repeated kernel flip events in the runtime logs: `kselector -> aux -> primary -> aux` within the same request life.

lee_infra: can you paste the selector logs? also kv cache hitrate during the window?

sam_runtime: pasted snippets below:
```
[17:23:58] selector: pick(primary) seq_len=1024 kernel=fast_attn
[17:24:01] selector: fallback(aux_quant) reason=latency_estimate_mismatch
[17:24:01] kvcache: read latency=12ms (miss) key=tenant:alpha:prefetch:123
[17:24:02] selector: pick(primary) seq_len=1024 kernel=fast_attn
[17:24:03] selector: fallback(aux_quant) reason=kernel_unavailable
```

kv hitrate dropped from 92% -> 68% in that 2m window. looks like a hotset churn.

anya_eng: that pattern smells like caching priming + kernel warmup mismatch. when selector flips to aux_quant the latency estimate increases and we see cascade of evictions. maybe prefetch sampler mis-sampled short seqs as long.

perf_bot: flamegraph (sampled CPU) uploaded: https://perf.internal/fg/1715558888 (span: 17:20-17:26)

lee_infra: grabbing queue dump now: `curl -s http://ops.internal/queues/dump?shard=42`

deploy_bot: incident created: INC-2026-0421 — "hosted-usw2 p99 spike (kernel shadowing)" assigned to eng-runtime oncall.

maria_sre: queue dump shows backlog mostly from tenant=alpha with many long-seq prompts and a small tail of short requests blocking coalescer. batching histogram attached.

sam_runtime: quick experiment idea: temporarily pin kernel selector to `primary` for shard-42 and enable conservative batching (max_batch_ms=3 -> 1). if p99 drops, we know selector churn is causal. can someone trigger a config roll?

lee_infra: rolling feature flag: `kselector.pin=primary` -> shards:42,43. lowering coalesce window via `coalesce_ms=1` on shard-42. applying now.

anya_eng: also recommend increasing kvcache prefetched keys for tenant alpha from 100 -> 1000 to reduce miss storm. planning a safe prefetch run with rate-limit.

sam_runtime: after flags: p99 down to ~900ms, queue depth back to ~18, kv hitrate recovering to 86%. initial signal looks positive.

maria_sre: logs confirm selector flip count dropped 87% in the next minute. good lead.

perf_bot: new flamegraph uploaded post-change: https://perf.internal/fg/1715558920 (span: 17:26-17:30)

lee_infra: next steps: 1) keep pin for 10m while we evaluate, 2) run kselector A/B with stabilized prefetch config, 3) add a guard to avoid selector choosing aux if kv-miss-rate > 20% for tenant.

anya_eng: filing a follow-up RFC for selector heuristics: include short/long sequence confidence smoothing, and prefetch-awareness; will attach perf traces.

sam_runtime: thanks all. recording incident notes in INC ticket and will schedule a perf triage tomorrow with runtime + infra + prefetch owners. :thumbsup:

maria_sre: closing loop here — leave the pin on for now, monitoring for regressions. if anyone sees adverse effects ping @sam_runtime or @lee_infra.
